data.one_liner: A Flutter package to display country flags using SVG assets.
data.what_it_does: Provides easy-to-use widgets to display national, regional, and international flags using ISO country codes or custom strings. It leverages flutter_svg under the hood and syncs flag graphics with the popular flag-icons repository.
use_when: You need to display country flags in your user profile, settings, or language selection screens.
You want support for standard ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country codes as well as various disputed territories and international organizations.
avoid_when: You already use an alternative package from the catalog that fulfills your flag-rendering needs.
strengths: Supports multiple flag dimensions and shapes (like 1x1, 4x3, rounded flags).
Uses vector graphics (SVG) ensuring crisp rendering across different screen densities.
Continuously synced with flag-icons library releases.
weaknesses: Relies on external SVG asset updates to keep flags accurate.
Limited to flag rendering functionality only.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package to your pubspec.yaml and start using the Flag widget.

alternatives.name: country_flags
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative package providing country flags for Flutter applications.
